title: Wealth inequality and monetary policy (Domanski, Scatigna, Zabai, BIS Quarterly Review, March 2016)
summary: BIS balance-sheet simulation: rising equity prices are the key driver of QE-linked wealth-inequality effects; bonds negligible; housing partly offsets. Caveats: partial-equilibrium only, does not establish a direct causal link to monetary policy, omits employment/growth channel; nexus research still nascent (2016).

bindings.note: 量化资产价格渠道内部构成:股票>房产>>债券,是资产价格渠道贡献份额的核心分解证据
作者明确声明反事实模拟不能建立与货币政策的直接因果链接,是识别难题的一手证据

title: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy and Wealth Inequality (Medlin & Epstein, PERI Working Paper No. 576, April 2023)
summary: LP-IV study: 100bp expansionary rate cut raises top10/top1 wealth share, Gini +0.005~0.015; MP explains Gini +0.012~0.013 (1976-2012). Contrasts Wolff(2021, Gini -0.045, equalizing via housing/debt erosion) and cites Bernanke(2015) structural-forces thesis. Documents 3 channels (savings redistribution/portfolio composition/inflation) and endogeneity critique of rival estimates.

bindings.note: 量化宽松式扩张性货币政策对财富份额/Gini的因果量级估计,及历史贡献度估算
Bernanke(2015)原话:不平等主要是结构性力量所致,货币政策影响『几乎肯定是温和且短暂的』
储蓄再分配渠道的理论机制定义,及Wolff(2021)相反方向证据(净房价/债务侵蚀效应利好中产)
LP-IV冲击识别法是分离货币政策边际因果效应的具体方法论范例
对Wolff(2021)的方法论批评(利率代理变量误差、央行与资产价格协动的内生性)是识别难题的具体例证

title: The Saving Glut of the Rich and the Rise in Household Debt (Mian, Straub & Sufi, NBER/RBA workshop paper, Nov 2019)
summary: Rising income inequality since 1980 generated a 'saving glut of the rich' (top1% saving contribution rose from 4.5pp of national income in 1970s to 9.5pp in 2010-14), comparable in scale to the global saving glut, and is argued as an independent structural driver of falling real interest rates -- reversing the presumed QE-to-inequality causal arrow.

bindings.note: 反向因果核心证据:收入不平等(而非QE)是压低实际利率、推高资产价格的结构性力量之一,量级可观且始于1980年代
反向因果/内生性论证的理论基础:若不平等本身驱动低利率环境,QE作为对该环境的响应,其『边际』因果效应难以与结构性趋势分离

title: Structural drivers of the neutral real rate (r-star): Rachel & Summers (2019, NBER 26198) and SF Fed Economic Letter (2025)
summary: Neutral real rate fell ~3pp since 1970s (Rachel & Summers); demographic aging and global capital-flow factors are the dominant estimated drivers pre-2019, with TFP/productivity playing a minor role (SF Fed 2025). These decompositions treat QE as a policy response to, not a determinant of, the r-star trend.

bindings.note: 老龄化与全球因素对r*下降的量化贡献,独立于QE的结构性解释

title: The distributional impact of monetary policy easing in the UK between 2008 and 2014 (Bunn, Pugh & Yeates, BoE SWP 720, 2018)
summary: UK microdata (Wealth & Assets Survey) study of QE+rate cuts 2008-2014: overall Gini impact 'small'; income gains favored the young, wealth gains favored the old/retirees; bottom-half wealth holders gained slightly MORE in percentage terms than top holders. Confirms saver-to-borrower redistribution but net inequality effect is small/ambiguous, not uniformly regressive.

bindings.note: 同期(2008-2014)最细粒度的微观分布式研究,直接回答方向问题:总体Gini效应小,方向因年龄/渠道而异,非单调累退

title: Monetary Policy and the Redistribution Channel (Auclert, AER 2018 / NBER WP 23451)
summary: Formalizes three redistribution channels of monetary policy (earnings heterogeneity, Fisher/inflation, interest-rate-exposure). Argues it is 'incorrect to claim that asset holders generally benefit' from rate falls -- the correct measure is each household's Unhedged Interest Rate Exposure (duration-mismatched net position, including human capital), not gross asset ownership.

bindings.note: 严格理论基础:说明储蓄者/借款者渠道的净方向取决于家庭资产负债久期错配(URE),而非简单的『有资产=获利』

title: Have We Underestimated the Likelihood and Severity of Zero Lower Bound Events? (Chung, Laforte, Reifschneider, Williams, FRBSF WP 2011-01)
summary: Fed staff structural-model counterfactual: securities purchases since late 2008 lowered unemployment by ~1.5pp relative to a no-purchase counterfactual by 2012, and probably prevented deflation -- a quantified example of QE's macro-stabilization channel.

bindings.note: 无QE反事实下失业率显著更高,佐证低财富家庭本会遭受更严重的失业/止赎冲击
美联储自身结构模型对QE就业渠道量级的量化估计(1.5个百分点)

title: The Unexpected Compression: Competition at Work in the Low Wage Labor Market (Autor, Dube & McGrew, NBER WP 31010, 2023)
summary: Post-pandemic labor-market tightness compressed wages, reducing the college wage premium and offsetting about one-third of the four-decade rise in 90/10 wage inequality, concentrated among young non-college workers. Attributes mechanism to tightness/reduced employer power, not explicitly to QE.

bindings.note: 紧俏劳动力市场对底层工资的『拉平』效应的最新、量化最清晰的证据
即使抵消三分之一的工资不平等趋势,相对于财富集中度的更大幅度上升,量级上仍可能不足以抵消资产价格渠道

title: Report Shows African Americans Lost Half Their Wealth Due to Housing Crisis and Unemployment (NLIHC summary)
summary: African American households lost over half their wealth 2007-2011 via foreclosure and job loss; foreclosure rate ~8% for Black/Latino households vs 4.5% for white households at similar income. Documents severity of the unmitigated-recession counterfactual for low-wealth households.

bindings.note: 记录深度衰退本身(而非QE)对低财富/少数族裔家庭造成的巨大财富损失,是反事实基准的经验背景

title: Monetary policy and inequality (ECB Economic Bulletin, Issue 2/2021)
summary: Euro-area analysis: policy easing raises lowest-income households' income >3% vs ~0.5% for other quintiles (equalizing); combined stock+house price effects leave net wealth Gini 'broadly unchanged' since broader European housing ownership offsets equity concentration. Employment/income and wealth-concentration channels move somewhat independently.

bindings.note: 就业/收入渠道与财富集中度渠道作用于不同分布(收入vs财富),并非机械抵消关系
跨国比较证据:欧元区房屋所有权结构不同,同样的QE『技术』净分配效应可不同于美国,是跨国比较识别策略的具体案例

title: Wealth Inequality and the Racial Wealth Gap (Aladangady & Forde, FEDS Notes, Oct 2021)
summary: US wealth Gini: 0.82(2007) -> 0.85(2010) -> 0.85-0.86(2013-2019), i.e. most of the post-crisis rise occurred by 2010 then plateaued. Total rise (~0.03) is several times larger than monetary policy's estimated ~0.012-0.013 contribution (DOC-0002), implying other factors dominate.

bindings.note: 美国财富Gini总升幅数倍于货币政策可归因部分,佐证就业渠道即便显著也难以在财富(而非收入)维度上抵消资产集中度上升

title: The Effects of Quantitative Easing on Interest Rates: Channels and Implications for Policy (Krishnamurthy & Vissing-Jorgensen, Brookings Papers on Economic Activity, Fall 2011)
summary: Canonical high-frequency event-study identification of QE1/QE2's effect on interest rates via multiple channels (signaling, safe-asset demand, inflation, MBS prepayment, default risk). Uses intraday windows around announcements to isolate causal price reactions from slow-moving confounds; identifies a local flow effect, not the cumulative multi-year stock effect.

bindings.note: 高频事件研究法的经典范例:窄时间窗口如何排除缓慢结构性趋势的混淆,及其局限(仅识别局部/流量效应,非全期存量效应)
